findings.title: Explicit LMTR title resolves to the mapped parent instead of LMTR
findings.input: Se aplicará el artículo 1 de la Ley en Materia de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión.
findings.expected: Resolve urn:lex-mx:federal:statute:lmtr:article:1 from exact configured full title; do not emit LAN1.
findings.mechanism: bare_word_follows accepts en + materia, so bare_parent_marker labels the title as shorthand. Parent candidate begins at de la Ley, earlier than configured full title beginning at Ley, and earliest-position selection chooses LAN. CLI automatically supplies unique full official titles, including exact committed LMTR title.
findings.suggested_regression: An exact named title beginning with an allowed connective must win over a bare-parent candidate from the same phrase; preserve legitimate bare Ley followed by later independent law citation.

findings.title: Unquoted anaphoric Ley/Código is treated as parent shorthand
findings.input: La Ley Federal del Trabajo es el ordenamiento en comento. Se aplicará el artículo 1 de la Ley en comento.
findings.expected: Either resolve stated LFT antecedent or safely leave unsupported anaphora unlinked; never infer LAN1.
findings.mechanism: en is accepted unless followed by cita; que is accepted unless followed by one finite title-verb list. Other explicit anaphoric forms pass the bare shorthand guard.

findings.suggested_regression: Refuse unquoted anaphoric en comento/que se cita (and equivalent code form) without retargeting to parent; retain bare Ley/Código controls.

findings.title: Equivalent dated reading bypasses vigente-until narrowing
findings.input: Se aplicará el artículo 1 de la Ley en vigor al 31 de diciembre de 1990.
findings.expected: Leave dated historical reading unlinked for review; never silently resolve to current LAN, whose recorded publication is1992-12-01.
findings.mechanism: Guard recognizes dated forms only under vigente. en + vigor and que + estaba are accepted as connective phrases, allowing explicitly dated reading to resolve to current parent.

related_variants.input: Se aplicará el artículo 1 de la Ley que estaba vigente al 31 de diciembre de 1990.

findings.suggested_regression: Equivalent dated wording en vigor al and que estaba vigente must be no more permissive than accepted vigente hasta control; do not invent a historical target.
